english.title: Ride an animal within Parliament Square Garden without permission
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within the central garden of Parliament Square, without the written permission of the Mayor or a person authorised by the Mayor to give such permission, rode an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..)
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaw 5(1)(l) of the Parliament Square Garden Byelaws 2012 and section 385(3) of the London Authority Act.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: (i) See byelaw 9 where a person must, on demand, provide their name and address should an authorised person have reasonable ground to believe a person has contravened the byelaws. (ii) See section 380 of the Greater London Authority Act 1999 for delegation of authority to grant permission to conduct this action.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, within the central garden of Parliament Square, without the written permission of the Mayor or a person authorised by the Mayor to give such permission, rode an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..).
